title: LMCache/LMCache Release v0.5.3rc3 · ROCm (gfx942, gfx950)
event_hint: LMCache v0.5.3rc3 ROCm wheel for AMD Instinct gfx942/gfx950
problem: AMD Instinct users need an LMCache build aligned with ROCm and the upstream vLLM ROCm container to run KV-cache experiments without ABI or dependency mismatches.
mechanism: The release provides a ROCm 7.2 LMCache v0.5.3rc3 wheel for gfx942 (MI300X/MI325X) and gfx950 (MI350X/MI355X), ABI-matched to vllm/vllm-openai-rocm with torch 2.11 and CPython 3.12. The release documents pip installation with --no-deps and the versioned expanded-assets directory.

evidence.claim: A ROCm 7.2 wheel is published for LMCache v0.5.3rc3.
The wheel targets AMD Instinct gfx942 (MI300X/MI325X) and gfx950 (MI350X/MI355X), matched to torch 2.11/cp312 in the upstream vLLM ROCm image.
The documented install uses pip with --no-deps and the release expanded-assets URL inside an upstream vLLM ROCm container.

evaluation_context: This official LMCache release is a packaging artifact for AMD/ROCm KV-cache infrastructure. It specifies supported architectures and software ABI targets but supplies no serving throughput, transfer latency, network utilization, or correctness measurements.
limitations: The release candidate does not establish performance or compatibility outside the stated ROCm 7.2, accelerator, PyTorch, Python, and vLLM versions. Packaging alone does not show that LMCache changes KV-cache placement or network scheduling. The GitHub page contains loading-error placeholders around the short body.
project_relevance: This enables reproducible LMCache deployments on MI300/MI350 hardware for later KV-cache transfer tests, but should be treated as an environment prerequisite rather than evidence of a TPN or network-performance improvement (inference).
source_notes: Facts extracted from the fetched official LMCache GitHub release page; title copied exactly from input metadata.
No performance claims were inferred from the packaging release.
